name: Forest 6174: Judy
summary:
In this expansion of Forest 6174, you'll once again play as Danny, but this time, you'll explore a darker and more unsettling side of him. Along the way, you'll finally uncover who Judy really is and what her true purpose has been from the beginning.

Set before the events of the main game, this short but intense chapter adds new layers of tension and meaning to the story of Forest 6174. A brief experience where every second counts.
